LESLIEVILLE BIA | MAY 2026 NEWSLETTER

Spring is finally here on Queen East!

1. STREET FESTIVAL DATES ANNOUNCED
The Leslieville Flea returns to Ashbridge Estate on Sundays May 24, June 28 and July 26, 10am-4pm. Over 80 vendors, vintage, makers, food trucks. Volunteers wanted for setup (8-10am).

The City of Toronto will replace the watermain on Queen St E between Leslie St and Jones Ave starting May 19. Expect lane restrictions eastbound, 7am-7pm weekdays, for about 9 weeks. Thanks to our sponsors, 46 new planters are going in along Queen this month. Adopt-a-planter sign-ups are open: you water it twice a week from June to September and get your family name on a little plaque.

Welcome to: Tidepool Books (children's and YA, 1102 Queen E), Hearth Bakehouse (sourdough and pastries, opening May 15), and Northbound Cycle (repairs and rentals, 1311 Queen E).

The 55 Division community safety walk is Thursday May 21 at 7pm, meeting at Jimmie Simpson Rec Centre. Light refreshments.

Green P lot at Coxwell & Queen will close for resurfacing June 1-14. Street parking permits are unaffected.
